__Fixed Spawn Locations__

Most Cultist spawn locations can be identified by the Cultist icon on the map.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_dec26ba376a34bc28e2946540d8b7918~mv2.jpg)

| Kanawha County Cemetery | Forest | 12 |
